_comment: Third-party sources that setup installs from upstream. Never copied into this repo. install-third-party.sh, NOTICE and the credits table in SETUP.md all read this list. An optional source is credited only, never installed; `./install-third-party.sh --check` fails when they drift apart.

sources.name: mattpocock/skills
sources.author: Matt Pocock
sources.used_for: The default review skill `code-review` in the Worker's completion steps. Optional modules: the refine skills `spec-task` and `spec-exploration` are derived in part from its skills (MIT, attribution in each `SKILL.md`) and use its `domain-modeling`; the capture rules name its `wayfinder`.

sources.author: The Herdr authors
sources.used_for: The recommended Runtime. The Owner installs the `herdr` program from its own docs.
